newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK's Western Harbour Crossing to open in April.
newsitem.headline: HK's Western Harbour Crossing to open in April.

text.p: Hong Kong's HK$7.5 billion Western Harbour Crossing will be open in April, four months ahead of schedule, chairman Robert Adams of the Western Harbour Tunnel Co Ltd said on Friday.

Adams said the overall project was 95 percent completed at the end of December, and facilities such as ventilation, environmental monitoring, toll collection and control systems were now being installed.
Western Harbour Tunnel Co Ltd is 37 percent owned by the Cross-Harbour Tunnel Co Ltd and 35 percent by CITIC Pacific Ltd.
